messages:
Maya CS: Heads-up 1: Artemis Labs onboarding triggered an unexpected tokens spike during bulk import. Need a QBR-ready blurb + immediate mitigations.
cli-bot: Alert: account=Artemis Labs usage +4.1x (24h). Predicted 7-day burn +480% :warning:
Diego (CSM): Do we know which endpoints? embeddings or chat?
Maya CS: Looks embeddings + NN scans. Quick snapshot: 24h_tokens=2.48M, calls=57, avg=43.5k, big_jobs=4.
Asha Finance: At current rate credits ~8 days left. I'll run a 30-day spend projection and flag renewal risk if cushion <25%.
Rahul Eng: Quick fixes we can flip now: route embeddings to low-cost embed-v1, enable batching (bs=64) and prefix caching. Proposed snippet:
```yaml
route: "/v1/embeddings" -> model: embed-v1-cost
batch_size: 64
cache_prefix: true
throttle: 50rps
```
Diego (CSM): I'll message the customer with a friendly note proposing a 7-day throttle + enablement session. Need approval on tone.
Maya CS: Draft approved. Offer a 30-min session this week and an optional short credit top-up if mitigation doesn't show results in 48h (finance sign-off).
cli-bot: Incident logged INC-2024210, severity=medium, owner=Diego (CSM)
Rahul Eng: Canary deployed to 10% traffic. Early metrics: token_savings~56%, median_latency +9ms, errors 0/250.
Asha Finance: Forecast updated: with mitigations runway extends to ~26 days; temporary 10% credit cushion buys ~6 days. Posting numbers to: https://docs.internal/redwood/artemis/forecast
Diego (CSM): Customer ACK'd the plan and agreed to the enablement. Will confirm after session and then we'll include the incident + savings in the QBR slide.
Maya CS: Great work team. Capture final numbers and timeline for QBR. Closing loop when Rahul confirms full rollout. :thumbsup:
